# Rotation

> Rotation is a closet and outfit log app. Log what you wear, see what you actually wear, track cost per wear, and share your outfit, shoe of the day or scent of the day. Free during the beta. No account. Data stays on your device.

Rotation runs in a phone's browser today and can be added to the home screen. App Store and Google Play versions are coming soon. Beta access is by DM on Instagram (@rotation.fit) or X (@rotationfit).

## Pages

- [Home](https://rotation.fit/): What Rotation does, screenshots, beta access steps and FAQ
- [How to organize your closet](https://rotation.fit/how-to-organize-your-closet/): An 8 step guide that starts with what you actually wear.
- [Digital wardrobe app](https://rotation.fit/digital-wardrobe-app/): What to look for in a digital wardrobe app, and how Rotation handles each point.
- [Closet organizer app](https://rotation.fit/closet-organizer-app/): Sort your closet into sections and see which pieces are resting.
- [Outfit planner app](https://rotation.fit/outfit-log-app/): Plan outfits on a calendar, log what you wore and see what you actually wear.
- [Cost per wear tracker](https://rotation.fit/cost-per-wear-tracker/): What cost per wear is, how to work it out and how to track it without a spreadsheet.
- [Shoe rotation app](https://rotation.fit/shoe-rotation-app/): Track your sneakers, set a shoe of the day and see which pairs are resting.
- [Scent of the day tracker](https://rotation.fit/scent-of-the-day-tracker/): Log your fragrance each day and share your scent of the day on its own.
- [Privacy policy](https://rotation.fit/privacy.html): No accounts, no ads, no analytics, no tracking
